topic: Traffic data discrepancies and calculation logic
summary_markdown:
The discussion focused on discrepancies in total traffic figures for different facility categories, particularly when a master facility is absent. It was noted that the current calculation logic for footfall sessions (counting one session if a person passes by and returns within an hour) needs clarification regarding whether this rule should apply only at the master facility level or also at the individual screen level.

Regarding data presentation, it was discussed that traffic metrics need clear naming conventions: 'Total Screen Traffic' vs. 'Total Traffic Screens,' and 'Footfall Traffic' vs. 'Total Traffic Footfall.' The team agreed to use a specific factor (4.1) for CityMedia rather than previously used figures (5.5).

Technical discussions included reviewing SQL field definitions related to session counting, confirming that the staging environment needs updating or redeploying for accurate data viewing.
decisions: The factor for CityMedia traffic should be set to 4.1.
Traffic metrics must use clear naming conventions: 'Total Screen Traffic' and 'Footfall Traffic'.
The session counting logic (one session within an hour) needs confirmation on whether it applies only at the master facility level or also at the screen level.
action_items: Clarify the scope of the one-hour re-entry footfall session calculation (master vs. screen level).
Update/redeploy the staging environment data set for testing.
